Open the project:
{link}

The RO-Crate export (zip) of project “{project}” is ready: {articles} articles, {pdf} PDF.

Download it from the results page (valid 7 days):
{link}

— The Diggypaper team
en.export_failed_body:
Hello,

The export of project “{project}” failed. Please try again from the results page:
{link}

— The Diggypaper team
en.account_disabled: This account is disabled. Contact the administrator.
en.retention_warn_subject: Diggypaper: project “{project}” will be deleted on {date}
en.retention_warn_body:
Hello,

The project “{project}” has had no activity for {days} days. To free disk space it will be deleted on {date} (articles, PDFs, analyses and reviews included).

To keep it, open the project and click “Keep this project”, or export it first (RO-Crate):
{link}

— The Diggypaper team
en.retention_deleted_body:
Hello,

The project “{project}” was deleted after {days} days without activity.

— The Diggypaper team
en.disk_alert_body:

The server disk is {percent} % full ({free} GB free of {total} GB). Database: {db} GB, stored PDFs: {pdf} GB.

Free space by deleting inactive projects or old exports: {link}

— The Diggypaper team
